_metadata.reviewer: Codex coordinating assistant; AI-assisted scope review, not independent human adjudication
_metadata.cross_source_duplicate_note: Qwen p1 and Shieldstral p1 have identical substantive text. If both are selected, retain their source identities and treat repeated transfer runs as replicas, not distinct authoring strategies.

p0.reason: Registered complete reference policy; dataset mapping and fixed scope reviewed.

policylm-p1.reason: Defines normal as non-offensive but includes profanity and personal insults, and replaces the instruction against assuming missing context. Does not faithfully preserve the original definitions and context constraint.

policylm-p2.reason: Same substantive text as rejected PolicyLM p1; retains its contradictory definition and missing context constraint.

shieldstral-p1.reason: Punctuation changes only; all intended rules, exceptions, covered groups and examples retained. Same substantive text as Qwen p1.

shieldstral-p2.reason: Adds a clarification that context distinguishes an identity attack from a descriptor or unrelated insult. Retains the original identity groups, prohibitions, exceptions, examples and instruction not to assume missing context.

qwen-4b-p1.reason: Punctuation changes only; intended scope and all substantive clauses retained. Same substantive text as Shieldstral p1.

qwen-4b-p2.reason: Exact substantive duplicate of Qwen p1. Exclude from selection so a second stochastic measurement of the same input cannot win by chance.
